about: Unified RIL v3 programs with machine (bool + bounded int + eventually liveness), promise, law, proof, and inline test blocks verify deterministically and fail closed on broken invariants, deadlocks, false proofs, or failing inline tests.
laws:
ril "v3-conformance" version 3

machine escrow
  states Open, Approved, Settled
  initial Open
  terminal Settled
  var approvals: int(0..2) = 0
  transition approve: Open -> Open when approvals < 2 set approvals = approvals + 1
  transition lock: Open -> Approved when approvals >= 2
  transition settle: Approved -> Settled
  invariant quorum: state == Settled => approvals >= 2
  eventually finishes: state == Settled

promise settle-escrow
  says "Escrow settles within 30s."
  why "Bounded settlement."
  for "settle_escrow"
  requires "approved"
  ensures "receipt_recorded"
  within 30s
  on_breach freeze

law read-doc
  says "Allow public reads unless suspended."
  why "Read safety."
  on action read of Doc
  permit when resource.public == true
  forbid when principal.suspended == true

proof forbid-wins
  proves "read-doc"
  for_all permit: bool, ask: bool
  assert verdict(permit, ask, true) == deny

test allow-public
  for "read-doc"
  principal User::"alice" { suspended: false }
  resource Doc::"r1" { public: true }
  expect allow

refused:
ril "bad-invariant" version 3

machine broken
  states A, B
  initial A
  terminal B
  var ok: bool = false
  transition go: A -> B
  invariant must-be-ok: state == B => ok
ril "bad-deadlock" version 3

machine stuck
  states A, B
  initial A
  terminal B
  var x: bool = false
  transition never: A -> B when x
ril "bad-proof" version 3

promise p
  says "x"
  why "y"
  for "act"
  requires "a"

proof lie
  proves "p"
  assert verdict(true, false, true) == allow
ril "bad-test" version 3

  on action read of Doc
  forbid when true

test wrong-expect
  for "read-doc"
  principal User::"a" {}
